dataset.benchmark: TPC-H generated by the pinned DuckDB tpch extension
dataset.departure_from_paper: Paper and artifact helper use SF10; SF1 is preregistered for this bounded mechanism replication and no cross-system absolute-runtime claim.

primary_workloads.reason: branch-rich selective predicate with one table scan; tests whether opaque compiled evaluation prevents native filter visibility
nested branch predicate across a join; tests predicate visibility and join/filter placement
released SQL-inside-procedure sample; tests query-motion/partial-representation support and is excluded from timing if the emitted residual is not executable

representation_variants.activation: default enabled PRISM compiler-pass map, transpile released PL/pgSQL, call generated outlined function through the documented DuckDB macro wrapper
repository-provided original TPC-H SQL in samples/tpch_queries_original.sql

unavailable_variants.OPAQUE: No documented executable unmodified PL/pgSQL engine mode in the released artifact.
unavailable_variants.FORCED_FULL_PRISM: No single documented force-full-exposure mode; pass disabling emits PL/pgSQL text but does not register an executable function.

hypotheses.H1_visibility: PRISM's chosen residual/exposed structure will be directly observable; relative to FULL_NATIVE_SQL, outlined predicates will be less visible in the DuckDB plan.
hypotheses.H2_reduced_exposure: PRISM_SELECTIVE exposes no more predicate/branch structure than FULL_NATIVE_SQL.
hypotheses.H3_decision_effect: At least one workload will change a natural filter, cardinality, join, or placement decision.
hypotheses.H4_optimization_tradeoff: Plan/transformation latency and representation size will differ.
hypotheses.H5_strategic_opacity: At least one workload may show an execution-versus-transformation tradeoff; this is not assumed.
hypotheses.H6_coverage: The SQL-inside-procedure case may remain non-executable in the released DuckDB artifact.

semantic_validation: Execute both variants on the same immutable database; compare ordered CSV result bytes and SHA-256 exactly (DECIMAL aggregates, no floating tolerance).
runtime_metrics: per-trial wall time reported by DuckDB timer

randomization.unit: one query execution in a persistent DuckDB CLI session
randomization.blocking: each repetition block contains each executable variant once

exclusion_rules: do not replace a failed workload after outcomes are observed
failure_rules: non-executable residual is excluded from performance pairing

analysis_formulas.bootstrap: 10000 resamples with seed 4042026; percentile 2.5% and 97.5% of medians

success_criteria: At least one exact semantic pair, visible transformed representation, captured plans, preserved transformation overhead, and unchanged prior artifacts.
boundary_criteria: Unsupported constructs, non-executable residual PL/pgSQL, absence of opaque/full controls, or timeout are reported without substitution.
